item.title: MICROSCORE-4348 Micros API outage to upgrade RDSs from db.t4g.large to db.m8g.large
item.description:
Apr 30, 06:43 UTC
Completed - The database upgrades have been completed successfully as planned. No issues have been observed, and everything is operating normally.

Apr 30, 06:31 UTC
Update - The infrastructure upgrade for the commercial production environment has been completed. The process took approximately 2 minutes, during which some requests may have returned errors. Service has been fully restored.

Apr 30, 06:04 UTC
Update - We've initiated the deployment of the fix to production environments. You may experience brief service interruptions of approximately 2–3 minutes, expected to begin within the next 10–15 minutes. We'll provide a further update once the deployment is complete.

Apr 30, 05:32 UTC
Scheduled - We are performing infrastructure upgrades to improve service performance. During this maintenance, you may experience two brief periods of service interruption, each lasting approximately 2–3 minutes. We will provide a further update once the upgrades are complete.

item.title: Issues with 403 user authentication errors across Atlassian products
item.description:
Mar 4, 07:31 UTC
Resolved - We are aware of an issue that was impacting user authentication to Atlassian services between 6:10AM Tuesday 4th March UTC and 6:35AM Tuesday 4th March UTC.
Users that were already logged in would not have been impacted by this issue.
A deployment suspected of causing this issue was rolled back and the problem was subsequently resolved.
